investigation_notes.Description: Anomalous volume of SharePoint downloads (300 files) was observed from the account using a Python/aiohttp user agent and identified application 'ChatGPT'. The activity occurred at 12:33 local time in Tallinn and closely matches a prior alert (SOC-11300) that was closed as a false positive after the client confirmed a ChatGPT-based automated synchronization. Sampled files (orders, contacts, inventory) appear operational in nature and the source IP, user agent, and endpoint are identical to the previously confirmed benign event, supporting a low-risk determination. Based on these correlations and the non-sensitive nature of the samples, this alert is assessed as Low Priority because it is consistent with expected automated synchronization rather than unauthorized exfiltration.
